integrity: Two separate exact enumerators based on duad-syntheme and binary-symplectic models reconstruct the graph, check all subsets of cardinality at most four, evaluate nonporous blocked-source weights, and verify the full optimizer-exchange geometry. All ordinary scholarly review beyond the stated internal technical review remains unperformed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite theorem for the canonical 30-vertex generalized-quadrangle incidence graph only. The supplied finite calculations verify, but do not replace, the explicit analytic necessity proof. No extension to other generalized quadrangles or all cubic graphs is asserted. Priority is conditional on the inspected literature and indexed comparisons; an unindexed earlier equivalent computation remains possible.
title: Flag rigidity and a three-replacement threshold for exponential domination in the Tutte–Coxeter graph
